title: CCI Clears Adani Energy Solutions' Rs 3,050 Crore Acquisition of IntelliSmart Infrastructure
case_name: Combination registered by Adani Energy Solutions Ltd. for acquisition of IntelliSmart Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd.
citation: CCI approval dated 30 October 2026; detailed order awaited
card_summary: The Competition Commission of India approved Adani Energy Solutions' acquisition of the entire equity of IntelliSmart Infrastructure for Rs 3,050 crore. The shares are being bought from NIIF and EESL under an agreement first signed in June 2026, which also covers redemption of NIIF's convertible debentures in IntelliSmart.
card_tip: In a staged regulatory and listing process, the CCI letter approving a combination is not the detailed order; keep tracking the formal order and the NCLT filing before treating the deal as closed.
verification_notes: Confirmed by three independent reports (The Week/PTI, The Hans India, GKToday) agreeing on the approval date, parties and consideration; the CCI's own press release text was not accessed directly.
